verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Sill is built for interactive control: touch, keyboard, Apple Pencil, trackpad gestures and clipboard. It also adapts quality when the host is holding frames back. However, no item mentions hardware (e.g. VideoToolbox) encoding, codecs, or any latency figure or low-latency design, so neither core element of the story is documented. The input features and adaptive-quality behavior are adjacent and earn no credit.

support.subject: As a power user, the stream is hardware-encoded and low-latency enough for interactive work, not just passive viewing
